analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Select the generated outer residual entailment disjunct, introduce variables and path conditions, preserve emp, unfold the case-specific result predicate, and discharge the selected pure constructor directly from branch hypotheses.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: All selected residual branches are emp-to-pure-and-emp entailments; no heap transformation is required.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Unfold one of the two seed result predicates and use path-condition equalities/disequalities plus reflexivity.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All four obligations come from the same function, use the same generated residual-return proof shape, and need no helpers. Four witnesses are below the controller limit of twelve, so one cohesive group minimizes handoff overhead without mixing unrelated strategies.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: For each witness, select the second outer disjunct (the pure residual entailment), introduce quantified variables and path hypotheses, preserve emp, unfold xizi_circular_area_is_full_result or xizi_circular_area_error_result, select the result-predicate constructor justified by the branch guard, and close concrete result equalities by reflexivity.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_pattern: All four return VCs reduce to a pure result-predicate fact after selecting the residual disjunct; witnesses 1 and 2 prove not-full, witness 3 proves full, and witness 4 proves the null error result.
proof_groups.space_plan: Use the residual emp branch; no descriptor or CharArray.full resource manipulation is required.
proof_groups.pure_plan: Use PreH1 readidx <> writeidx for witness 1, PreH1 b_status = 0 for witness 2, PreH2 readidx = writeidx plus PreH1 b_status <> 0 for witness 3, and predicate unfolding/reflexivity for witness 4.
